c=catalog.Catalog()
c.put('Straße',1)
assert c.get('STRASSE')==1
assert c.get('strasse')==1
c.put('STRASSE',2)
assert len(c.values)==1 and c.get('straße')==2
# NFC: composed vs decomposed

assert c2.get('é')==7
c3=catalog.Catalog(); c3.put('é','x')
assert c3.get('é')=='x'
# KeyError on missing
for m in ('get','remove'):
    try: getattr(c3,m)('nope')
